release_notes:
v1.1.0 Release - Waveshare CAN Fixed 20-Byte mode support and GUI/Logging Performance Optimizations.

New Features:
  - Waveshare CAN Fixed 20-Byte Protocol: Supported building and writing CAN standard and extended frames with 20-byte fixed length.
  - GUI Event Loop Optimization: Batched raw console logging at 60 Hz and bypassed hidden plots calculations, cutting CPU overhead dramatically.
  - Asynchronous Decoded Logging: Moved all signal formatting, enum resolution, and sheet cycle building completely to the background worker thread, eliminating log-induced UI stuttering.
  - Port Auto-Discovery Refresh: The connection dialog dynamically scans and updates available ports list every 1.0 second.
